vocab.exampleEn: Teachers should clarify the task before students start writing.
vocab.exampleZh: 学生开始写作前，老师应该把任务讲清楚。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use clarify the question/goal/requirement in study and work topics.
vocab.upgradeZh: 常用搭配：clarify the question / goal / requirement。

cycle.summaryEn: Do listening and reading like the real test, then check the mistakes right away.
cycle.summaryZh: 像正式考试一样做听力和阅读，然后立刻订正。

frame.useEn: Use when comparing ideas or data.

meaningEn: This writing word helps Becky build stronger IELTS paragraphs and ideas.
meaningZh: 这个写作词可以帮助 Becky 写出更强的雅思段落和观点。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "clarify" using Compared with ..., ...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "clarify" 和 与……相比，... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
